A top-shelf pistol found only in the hands of the world's elite... or those brave enough to take it from them.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Long Barrel Pistol

Damage: 3d6/2d6 • Capacity: 40 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Pistol Autosear, Pistol Long Barrel, Smart Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 4 rounds in a burst. If there are not 4 rounds left in the magazine, Single Shot expends the entire magazine and deals 1d6 less damage (2d6). All ammunition fired from this weapon also functions as EMP Ammunition that still deals damage. When making an Autofire Attack with this weapon, the user may choose to attempt hitting up to 3 additional visible, valid targets whom are within 10m/yds of the initial target. Each additional target also requires expending 2 extra rounds of ammunition to attempt hitting. When done, the user makes a single Autofire Check to attempt hitting all chosen targets in this area and rolls damage once for all targets, like a Shotgun Shell.

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Long Barrel Pistol
Pre-installed: Pistol Autosear, Pistol Long Barrel, Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Listed damage is 3d6/2d6; the sheet uses the first value.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
